recruiterCard.summary: A football analysis lab built on real player-tracking data: replay a possession, see the space, pressure and passing options behind a decision, and ask "what if?" under stated assumptions. Version 1.0 was released in November 2026, with a public demo.
impactBullets: Works from two tracking providers, never pooled: 3 Metrica matches (optical, 25 Hz) and 20 SkillCorner A-League matches (broadcast, 10 fps), with checksum-pinned downloads and data-quality gates.
Evaluates every model leave-one-match-out, separately per provider: spatial context read 0.2 s before the pass lowered pass-outcome log loss in every held-out match (3 of 3 and 20 of 20).
Labels every value as observed, derived, estimated, hypothetical or simulated, and reports negative results next to the positive ones.
Serves the analysis through FastAPI to a React and Canvas lab with a guided tour, packaged with Docker.
